metrics.name: Fraud Prevented Amount
metrics.description: Total fraud value stopped by real-time blocking before it completed. The headline effectiveness number for the fraud program.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_prevented_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(detected_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_prevented_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Loss Amount
metrics.description: Total fraud value that completed and was lost (not prevented). The net leakage the program is judged against.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_lost_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(detected_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_lost_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Attempted Amount
metrics.description: Total fraud value attempted across all episodes (prevented plus lost). The gross fraud pressure on the book.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_attempted_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(detected_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_attempted_inr), 0) AS value FROM fraud_episodes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Prevention Rate
metrics.description: Share of attempted fraud value that was prevented rather than lost. The core risk-effectiveness ratio.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_prevented_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_attempted_inr), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_episodes
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(detected_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_prevented_inr) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_attempted_inr), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_episodes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Episodes
metrics.description: Count of distinct fraud incidents (each groups all fraudulent transactions on one compromise).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM fraud_episodes
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(detected_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fraud_episodes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Confirmed Fraud Transactions
metrics.description: Transactions flagged as confirmed fraud (ground truth). Rare by design — reason in basis points.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE is_fraud_flag = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE is_fraud_flag = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Rate
metrics.description: Share of all transactions that are confirmed fraud. A few basis points is healthy for an issuer.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_fraud_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS value FROM transactions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_fraud_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS value FROM transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Alerts Raised
metrics.description: Total fraud alerts raised for analyst review. The top of the fraud-operations funnel.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM fraud_alerts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(alert_sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fraud_alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Alert False-Positive Rate
metrics.description: Share of dispositioned alerts that turned out to be false positives. High by design — recall is prioritized over precision.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition = 'FALSE_POSITIVE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition IN ('TRUE_POSITIVE','FALSE_POSITIVE')), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(alert_sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition = 'FALSE_POSITIVE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition IN ('TRUE_POSITIVE','FALSE_POSITIVE')), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Alert Precision
metrics.description: Share of dispositioned alerts that were true fraud. The complement of the false-positive rate.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition = 'TRUE_POSITIVE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition IN ('TRUE_POSITIVE','FALSE_POSITIVE')), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(alert_sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition = 'TRUE_POSITIVE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition IN ('TRUE_POSITIVE','FALSE_POSITIVE')), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Avg Analyst Handle Time (min)
metrics.description: Average time an analyst spends resolving an alert, in minutes. The core queue-efficiency metric.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(handle_time_s) / 60.0, 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts WHERE handle_time_s IS NOT NULL
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(alert_sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(AVG(handle_time_s) / 60.0, 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts WHERE handle_time_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: SLA Breach Rate
metrics.description: Share of alerts that breached their resolution SLA. A queue-health and staffing signal.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(alert_sent_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM fraud_alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Chargeback Win Rate
metrics.description: Share of resolved chargebacks won at the network. The recovery-effectiveness metric for confirmed fraud.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE chargeback_status = 'WON') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE chargeback_status IN ('WON','LOST','REPRESENTED')), 0), 1) AS value FROM case_resolutions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(case_opened_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE chargeback_status = 'WON') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE chargeback_status IN ('WON','LOST','REPRESENTED')), 0), 1) AS value FROM case_resolutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Zero-Liability Case Share
metrics.description: Share of fraud cases resolved with zero customer liability (RBI: reported within 3 working days).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE liability_outcome = 'ZERO_LIABILITY') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM case_resolutions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(case_opened_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE liability_outcome = 'ZERO_LIABILITY') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM case_resolutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Total Card Spend
metrics.description: Approved purchase value across the card book. The denominator for fraud-loss-rate math.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE response = 'APPROVED' AND txn_type = 'PURCHASE'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(amount_inr), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE response = 'APPROVED' AND txn_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
